LESSON: CONTEMPORARY DANCE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.10: Contemporary Dance
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Contemporary Dance, part of Creating and Performing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS.

Key inquiry question: when watching virtual dance. How can contemporary dance be made interesting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe performing techniques used in contemporary dance,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Dance in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. create a 3-5-minute contemporary dance routine,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Dance in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. perform a 3-5-minute contemporary dance routine to an audience,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Dance in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the use of contemporary dance as a means for self-expression.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Contemporary Dance in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

A. describe performing techniques used in contemporary dance,

   Contemporary Dance helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. create a 3-5-minute contemporary dance routine,

   Contemporary Dance helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. perform a 3-5-minute contemporary dance routine to an audience,

   Contemporary Dance helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate the use of contemporary dance as a means for self-expression.

   Contemporary Dance helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Watch real or virtual contemporary dance performances to discuss performance techniques. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. Screen resolution and light intensity could be regulated for learners who are sensitive to light

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Watch real or virtual contemporary dance performances to discuss performance techniques. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. Screen resolution and light intensity could be regulated for learners who are sensitive to light

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Contemporary Dance together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: the learner boosts self-esteem, self-expression and mastery of concepts in dance creation.

• Digital literacy: the learner gains skills on the use of technological devices to create different visual and audio materials

using appropriate ICT tools for dance creation.

• Communication: the learner fluently communicates research findings and listens to narratives on pertinent issues in the

society that can be addressed using contemporary dance.

• Collaboration: the learner presents research findings, rehearses and performs the dance routine as a troupe.

• Creativity and imagination: the learner applies artistic and innovative abilities to decorate a costume using batik technique.

Values:
• Respect: the learner gains respect for others’ opinions while creating and sharing on dance creation.

• Responsibility: the learner acquires self-discipline as when creating contemporary dance within the timeline given.

• Social justice: the learner gains appreciation for modern and contemporary dance styles from diverse cultures and historical

periods.

44

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social Cohesion: the learner appreciates diversity by creating dances on national themes.

• Ethnic and racial relations: the learner is acquainted with diverse dance techniques in various ethnic and racial cultures that

enables them nurture respect for varied cultures of the world.

• Health education: the learner gets insight into various thematic health concerns like, HIV/AIDS, alcohol and substance abuse,

lifestyle diseases, personal hygiene, among others as they sketch storylines for contemporary dance performance.

Link to other Learning areas

• Social Studies: the learner gains interest and develops interest in issues in the society like good governance, child rights,

human rights and responsibilities that relate to the subject.

• Pre-technical Studies: the learner uses ICT devices to research from the internet and watch contemporary dance

performances.

• English or Kiswahili: the learner applies writing skills in scripting the dance story.

Main points to remember:

1. describe performing techniques used in contemporary dance,
2. create a 3-5-minute contemporary dance routine,
3. perform a 3-5-minute contemporary dance routine to an audience,
4. appreciate the use of contemporary dance as a means for self-expression.

Remember the key question: when watching virtual dance. How can contemporary dance be made interesting?
